assertion_review.fails_if: Fixture tick does not release or station fails to reach the held tick; setup liveness checks, not regression coverage.

Disk holder is absent, PID unexpectedly exists, dispatch removes/replaces the lease, renewal stops past 0.5 seconds, or guard closes; holder() independently rereads persisted state rather than echoing the supplied owner.
Dispatch requests another station, station thread cannot finish, or real run_station raises; restoring namespace-blind release fails the disk-holder assertion before these consequences.
Initial claim fails, disk record cannot be read, or foreign/missing namespace permits early release and unlinks the lease; restoring the old release_holder fails line 124 in both parameter cases.
Same-namespace claim/read fails or valid dead-holder cleanup is overrestricted or leaves the file; replacing release_holder with unconditional refusal fails line 134.
Cross-namespace reader reattaches or changes ownership so the original cannot renew; restoring the old host/pid/job-only match fails line 146.

Real successor is treated as owned, guard loss is not propagated, guard.check allows a write, token is altered or original release deletes successor; unconditional renewal success fails line 161 and guard refusal suppression fails line 164.

caveats: No attribution of every historic StationLeaseLostError is established; the live renewing lease and base regression demonstrate one real cause.
Coordinator owns refreshing all old lease readers and the two-hour production observation.
Importer receipts ran at implementation commit 84b64e24adf42c265c32b795524fe82d47a6f21b; only the evidence HTML differs at reviewed head.
Lint cleanliness is recorded in the source manifest; no standalone lint receipt was supplied.
independence_review: No added assertion is a self-fulfilling input/output equality: disk-holder and successor-token comparisons read actual file state; fixture liveness assertions are not counted as the namespace guard.
